title: ESP32 USB, USB CDC, and USB HID capabilities

spans.text: A USB-C connector does not mean the chip supports USB HID. Some boards use a USB-to-serial bridge only for flashing. Certain ESP32-S2/S3 boards with native USB OTG can expose CDC and HID; verify the exact board and Arduino core configuration.

spans.caption: ESP32 USB, USB CDC, and USB HID capabilities

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: This sketch is only for typing test text into your own computer in a trusted lab. Do not use USB HID for unauthorized actions on other devices. USB pins and power circuitry are board-specific.
